body.x: Blue Feel will exhibit portable air purifiers and minihead portable fans at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition inLas Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri), 2019.

Blue Feel, a company specializing in the manufacture ofportable smart devices, started in C-Lab, Samsung Electronics' in-house venturedevelopment program. It was finally selected for recognition of its proprietarytechnologies for motors and fans in the second half of 2017 and received thehighest amount of investment from Samsung Venture Investment Capital. It has aprimary goal of solving the small inconvenience people experience in theireveryday lives through technology and ideas, and ultimately aims to improve thequality of life for many people nearest to their customers.

The Portable Air Purifier is an air purifier that canblock fine dust while breathing comfortably because it does not block themouth. A comprehensive air solution is possible by interworking with variousIoT-based smartphone applications that can be used in a variety of spaces suchas cars, strollers, offices, cafes, etc., in order to send clean airdirectionally and not to purify the entire air.

The mini-head Portable Fan has been reduced in weight andsize by half, but it is a portable fan that doubles in wind strength and usagetime. It is a super-powered fan with a maximum wind speed of 40km/h by usingthe drone motor technology.

On the other hand, Seongnam IndustryPromotion Agency participating in CES 2019 is an organization that is in chargeof providing financial support for SMEs and venture companies in Seongnam. Ithelps companies with global investors and buyer networking and promotions. Italso actively supports the participation in CES 2019 as a part of the globalexport business development program.
